skill.summary: 笔尖写作专家：三要素收集 → 调用笔尖AI生成文章 → 输出可发布内容。Use when user asks to 用笔尖写文章 / 生成公众号文章 / 写一篇文章.

latestVersion.changelog: Initial release. Integrates with Bijian AI platform for multi-genre article creation (tech/emotion/military/review/trending). Supports custom writing styles and spaces. Three-element driven workflow with auto material enhancement for 5 article types.
